keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Gabriel Magalhães (Arsenal).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Liverpool 0, Arsenal 1. Kai Havertz (Arsenal) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Declan Rice with a cross.
Bradley Barcola (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Liverpool 0, Arsenal 1.
Noni Madueke (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Liverpool. Dominik Szoboszlai replaces Trey Nyoni.
Substitution, Arsenal. Myles Lewis-Skelly replaces Bruno Guimarães.
Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Liverpool. Rio Ngumoha replaces Cody Gakpo.
Delay in match because of an injury Milos Kerkez (Liverpool).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jurriën Timber (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card.
Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Liverpool. Kostas Tsimikas replaces Milos Kerkez.
Substitution, Liverpool. Víctor Muñoz replaces Ronald Araujo.
Substitution, Liverpool. Lewis Koumas replaces Florian Wirtz.
Substitution, Arsenal. Piero Hincapié replaces Christos Tzolis.
Substitution, Arsenal. Viktor Gyökeres replaces Kai Havertz.
Substitution, Arsenal. Mikel Merino replaces Martin Ødegaard.
David Raya (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card.
Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card.
